scope: Functional supported OS/apps and active compute-C retirement into Rust/reviewed assembly. Read-only source/artifact investigation; no shared edits or workload. Historical failures/scores unchanged.

decision.P-M07-01: Recommend accepting the conservative declaration below as the literal requirements declaration. It deliberately requires support for possibly used MPX3/4 and PKRU9; it does not assert their use or absence. Exact linked full-mask/full-extent mechanism is independently corroborated below. Dispatcher/independent reviewer owns the status edit.
decision.P-M07-02: Already complete in current worklist. No new runtime, logical behavior or per-class preservation credit here.
decision.whole_M07: Do not automatically mark complete from this report. Existing actual observations cover YMM/SSE and selected x87/MXCSR; MPX/PKRU get structural full-mask/full-extent support, not a new observed preservation claim. A focused reviewer can now decide the requirements-to-coverage join using these exact linked bodies and retained practical checks, without requiring whole-startup non-use. If actual MPX/PKRU preservation must be observed to close the whole exit, identify that separately; no new guest is authorized or specified here.

conservative_declaration.rule: For every selected application/library path, require preservation of every enabled user xstate component represented by the process XCR0 readback; the known exposed0x21f profile gives R={0:x87,1:SSE/MXCSR,2:YMM upper,3:MPX BNDREGS,4:MPX BNDCSR,9:PKRU}. This is a justified architectural upper bound, not evidence that exposure implies execution. It includes all state of every legal eligible dispatch variant under that profile.
conservative_declaration.mpx_actual_use: Unresolved; retained and newly inspected selected entry bodies contain no direct MPX instructions. Declared possible and required support; no no-use inference.
conservative_declaration.pkru_actual_use: Unresolved; exact dynamic libc contains rdpkru/wrpkru in pkey APIs. Declared possible and required support; symbol presence and OSPKE clear are not used to infer use/non-use.
conservative_declaration.AVX512: Known observed0x21f profile lacks xstate5/6/7 and CPUID7.EBX.AVX512F. Do not advertise AVX512. Current205 implementation reads the complete runtime mask/extent rather than hardcoding0x21f; this report does not relabel old08210 exposure capture as a new ff4f readback.
conservative_declaration.scope_preserved: Baseline dynamic C, baseline static Rust, selected vector probes, and current205 mixed/FP-thread apps remain included. Other selected applications remain subject to the same all-enabled-state requirement; the accepted20 pair is not substituted for the entire supported suite. No flags, binaries or exposure are narrowed.

identity_references.reuse_note: Artifact/report identities reused from retained bindings, not freshly rehashed. Static reads target the retained paths; current working-tree source is not used as exact ff4f proof.

compiler_and_application_declaration.FP_thread: Exact current app1.rs includes fp_state.S, which directly loads/stores YMM0..15 and changes/restores x87 CW and MXCSR. It gates AVX/XSAVE/OSXSAVE and XCR0 bits0..2. This is positive known use within R, not a bound on libc.
compiler_and_application_declaration.new_distinct_ELF_checks: In each baseline6d1865a0/current024fa562/current1f51f0e3 ELF, directly inspected memchr detect installs that ELF own find_sse2. Current two find_sse2 target bodies were independently read and contain scalar/SSE instructions with no MPX/PKRU. Each ELF memmove resolver independently offers SSE/SSSE3/ERMS/AVX/AVX512 target names. These are scoped direct observations, not a transfer of old findings or a whole-library state closure.

exact_ff4f_linked_mechanism: init_fpu@fffffffffe81a8e0 stores CPUID.D0.ECX to xsave_size@fffffffffe9422c8; reads/updates XCR0 through xgetbv/xsetbv and stores the full readback to xsave_mask@fffffffffe9422c0. It snapshots the complete mask to a4096-byte aligned initial_fp_regs buffer when xsave_size<=4096.2696 fits; the mask is not reduced to7.

save_fp_regs@fffffffffe81d450 loads the complete mask/size/available globals into the actual Rust provider@fffffffffe894af0. Rust allocates rounded(size,4096), zeros it, returns ENOMEM on allocation failure, and executes XSAVE atfffffffffe894ba1 with EDX:EAX formed from the complete64-bit mask.

copy_fp_regs@fffffffffe81d490 passes runtime xsave_size to rust_x86_copy_fp_regs@fffffffffe894690. The Rust provider rounds allocation to pages and calls memcpy@fffffffffe872330 atfffffffffe894778 with runtime size in RDX. No1088-byte struct truncation and no class-specific exclusion.

restore_fp_regs@fffffffffe81d4c0 passes full mask to rust_x86_restore_fp_regs@fffffffffe8949d0. Non-null state XRSTOR@fffffffffe894a0a uses both mask halves; initial-state XRSTOR@fffffffffe894ac3 also uses both. The FINIT/LDMXCSR fallback is separately visible and is not promoted to full extended-state reset proof.

do_signal@fffffffffe8231b0 obtains configured runtime size and full get_xsave_mask, allocates size+64 with64-byte alignment, zeroes configured bytes and XSAVE@fffffffffe823df5 uses both mask halves. copy_to_user@fffffffffe823e1a receives configured size. This includes the complete standard area when the supported profile extent is2696.

arch_native_signal_restore_fp_bridge@fffffffffe8217c0 requires provided size to match configured size, allocates size+63/alignment64, copies all configured bytes, passes the full mask to native_xstate_validate_result and native_xrstor_checked. Validator@fffffffffe876ce0 permits XSTATE_BV bits within the supplied mask; it does not mask those bits down to7. It rejects compacted header/reserved bytes and invalid MXCSR. native_xrstor_checked@fffffffffe825970 executes XRSTOR@fffffffffe82597a with full EDX:EAX. Thus there is no observed mask/extent exclusion ofMPX3/4 orPKRU9 on normal non-null signal frames.

bounded_libc_findings.pkru_candidates: Dynamic libc pkey_get@0x106c00 contains RDPKRU@0x106c0b; pkey_set@0x106c80 contains RDPKRU@0x106c92 and WRPKRU@0x106cad. Baseline C imports no pkey API, but that alone does not prove transitive library non-use.
bounded_libc_findings.entry_scope: Selected dynamic libc startup/early-init/pthread-create/start-thread/create-thread/clone-internal and loader startup/TLS/CPU-feature entry bodies inspected directly show no MPX/PKRU instructions. They have transitive/indirect calls; their absence is not extrapolated to all library code.
bounded_libc_findings.stop: Conservative all-enabled-state declaration removes the need to chase those calls solely to prove non-use. No broader callgraph/library audit proposed.

coverage_and_limits.observed_preservation: Reuse accepted x87/SSE/YMM syscall/blocking-futex/signal evidence and current205 FP-thread/pair observations under their original exact image/profile limits.
coverage_and_limits.structural_join: MPX3/4 andPKRU9 fit the complete runtime standard-XSAVE mask/area mechanism above. This is linked-artifact support, not hardware observation of noninitial MPX/PKRU values surviving each boundary.
not_claimed: MPX/PKRU instructions executed by selected apps
coverage_and_limits.smallest_remaining_decision: Independent requirements-to-coverage review: accept conservative R plus complete linked mechanism and existing relevant actual checks as sufficient for the functional M07 exit, or name the specific uncovered actual used-state requirement. Do not turn unresolved use into an unconditional new guest requirement.
